hook: Your GTA six preorder does not cost seventy-nine ninety-nine. It costs way more.
open_loop: Line 2 promises 'Watch Benny's total more than double' and the running counter climbs all video; the real year-one total ($195.87, more than double $79.99) is revealed only in line 12, with the 'wait, what?' twist (upgrading lands exactly on the Ultimate price) in line 8.
payoff: Benny's real year-one total is $195.87: $79.99 + $20 upgrade = $99.99, plus 12 months of a forgotten GTA+ trial ($95.88). Fix: pick your edition once, cancel the trial the same day.

lines.text: Your GTA 6 preorder does not cost $79.99. It costs way more.
lines.say: Your GTA six preorder does not cost seventy-nine ninety-nine. It costs way more.
lines.visual: SCENE 1 (frame 0, first word by 0.5 s): Benny (hoodie, controller in one hand, phone in the other) at a generic store counter, pose point, expr smug. Big price sign '$79.99' already on screen at frame 0; a red STRIKE slashes through it on 'not' (thud) and Benny's smile drops (expr shocked). SCENE 2 (on 'It'): a running TOTAL counter appears top-right at '$79.99' and wobbles upward on 'way more'; camera snap-zoom on Benny, pose shock.

lines.text: It is launch day. Watch Benny's total more than double.
lines.visual: SCENE 3 (on 'It'): generic calendar badge 'LAUNCH DAY' drops (ding); Benny pose flex, expr happy, wallet in hand. On 'double' a gold badge 'x2?' pops next to the TOTAL counter (still $79.99); Benny glances at the camera, expr smug (gag: he has no idea).

lines.text: He shakes the store box. There is no disc.
lines.visual: SCENE 4 (on 'He'): Benny holds a plain generic game box (no logos) to his ear and shakes it hard (pose present, expr thinking); a tiny sound bubble 'rattle?' gets crossed out (silence gag). On 'no disc' badge 'NO DISC' stamps (thud); Benny expr shocked.

lines.text: It is just a download code. He goes digital.
lines.visual: SCENE 5 (on 'It'): the box pops open and a single small card flutters out, badge 'DOWNLOAD CODE'; Benny pose shrug, expr smirk-annoyed. On 'digital' he tosses the box over his shoulder (bonk sound off-screen) and holds up his phone, badge 'DIGITAL'.

lines.say: Ultimate is listed at ninety-nine ninety-nine.
lines.visual: SCENE 6 (on 'Ultimate'): generic phone shop screen splits into two cards: 'STANDARD $79.99' and 'ULTIMATE $99.99' (gold); the Ultimate card glows on 'ninety-nine'. Benny pose think, expr thinking, eyebrows jump at the price.

lines.say: He picks Standard to save twenty dollars.
lines.visual: SCENE 7 (on 'He'): Benny taps 'STANDARD $79.99' (click); badge 'SAVED $20' pops on 'twenty'; Benny pose flex, expr smug, a tiny graduation cap lands on his head (gag: he feels like a genius). TOTAL counter stays $79.99.

lines.text: That night, he pays $20 to upgrade.
lines.say: That night, he pays twenty dollars to upgrade.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'That'): night tint, Benny in bed scrolling the phone (pose scroll, expr thinking), the Ultimate card glows at him. On 'upgrade' he taps it; badge '+$20 UPGRADE' flies into the TOTAL counter (cha-ching); the graduation cap falls off his head.

lines.text: Now he has paid $99.99, the Ultimate price!
lines.say: Now he has paid ninety-nine ninety-nine, the Ultimate price!
lines.visual: SCENE 9 (on 'Now'): TOTAL counter rolls $79.99 -> $99.99 and lands on 'ninety-nine'; on 'Ultimate' it slides next to the 'ULTIMATE $99.99' card and the two numbers match with a ding. Benny face-palms (pose slump, expr broke); the 'SAVED $20' badge deflates like a balloon. Wait-what beat.

lines.text: His digital preorder came with one free month of GTA+.
lines.say: His digital preorder came with one free month of GTA plus.
lines.visual: SCENE 10 (on 'His'): a gift box pops out of the phone with badge 'GTA+ 1 FREE MONTH' on 'free'; Benny pose wave, expr happy, hugs the gift (gag: suspiciously happy music sting).

lines.text: He forgets to cancel. Now it costs $7.99 a month.
lines.say: He forgets to cancel. Now it costs seven ninety-nine a month.
lines.visual: SCENE 11 (on 'He'): Benny plays happily (pose present, controller), a sticky note 'CANCEL TRIAL' falls behind the couch unseen. On 'Now' a wall calendar flips one page and bites a coin out of Benny's wallet; badge '$7.99 A MONTH' on 'seven'. Benny expr shocked.

SCENE 12 (on 'One'): the calendar flips fast 12 times, each flip a coin bonks Benny's head (12 quick bonks, comedic); a counter beside it rolls to '$95.88' on 'ninety-five'. Benny pose worry, expr broke, sweat drops.

lines.text: His real total for the year is $195.87. That is more than double.
lines.say: His real total for the year is one hundred ninety-five eighty-seven. That is more than double.
lines.visual: SCENE 13 (on 'His'): a receipt prints from the phone and keeps unrolling to the floor (gag); equation slams in rows: '$99.99 + $95.88' then '= $195.87' (gold) on 'one hundred'. SCENE 14 (on 'That'): the old '$79.99' sign sits small next to the big '$195.87'; badge 'MORE THAN x2' stamps on 'double' (thud), closing the 'x2?' from line 2. Benny pose shock, expr shocked, jaw drops.

lines.text: Pick your edition once. Cancel the trial the same day. Not financial advice.
lines.visual: SCENE 15 (on 'Pick'): rewind effect (tape whoosh) back to the store counter; Benny pose determined, expr determined, slaps a sticky note 'PICK ONCE' on the phone. On 'Cancel' a phone reminder 'CANCEL TRIAL TODAY' pops with a check mark; Benny pose hero, expr happy. On 'Not' small footer 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE'.

lines.text: Did you pick Standard or Ultimate? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 16 (on 'Did'): Benny on a couch with a generic 'LAUNCH DAY' screen behind him (no game footage), pose point at viewer on 'Comment', expr smile. List rows 'A: STANDARD' on 'Standard' and 'B: ULTIMATE' on 'Ultimate'. End on 'B'.

facts_used.claim: Rockstar's official GTA VI page says 'Coming November 19, 2026' (today). We only say 'launch day'; we never say it is out, playable or reviewed.
Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99 (US); Standard buyers can later pay the $20 difference to upgrade.
The boxed 'physical edition' is only a download code with no disc in the box (as reported), same $79.99 price as digital.
Digital pre-orders include one month of GTA+, which can convert to a paid subscription if not cancelled in time.
GTA+ costs $7.99 per month in the US. 12 x $7.99 = $95.88 a year.

math_check: $99.99 - $79.99 = $20.00. $79.99 + $20.00 = $99.99 (= Ultimate). 12 x $7.99 = $95.88. $99.99 + $95.88 = $195.87 (year one, trial never cancelled). $79.99 x 2 = $159.98 < $195.87, so 'more than double' is true. Every figure identical in say (spoken), text (caption) and on_screen: $79.99, $99.99, $20, $7.99, $95.88, $195.87. Note: the first free month is free, so 12 paid months strictly fall in the 13 months after launch; the script says 'one year costs' (the price of a year of GTA+), which is exact, and 'real total for the year' follows the research file's year-one total. Spoken words: 137 (counted by whitespace on 'say' or 'text'); longest sentence 11 words. 137 / 2.3 = 59.6 s.

upload.description:
The price tag is not the price you pay. Benny found out the hard way.
Did you pick Standard or Ultimate? Comment A or B.
Standard is listed at $79.99 and Ultimate at $99.99, so a $20 upgrade later costs exactly the Ultimate price. Forget to cancel the free GTA+ month and it is $7.99 a month, or $95.88 a year.
Not financial advice. Prices listed in US dollars, check the store. Unofficial fan commentary, not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.
